title: Holding FloodGuard Credit Balances Against Other Larkspur Balances
content:
**Account services rule — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy credit balances**

The credit balance of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy premium account is held back against other Larkspur balances of the customer as follows, the held-back amount staying on this premium account for that balance: when the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy at the same property address shows an amount owed, that amount is held back from the refund in full, up to the credit balance; when that HomeGuard policy shows nothing owed and a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy (Larkspur Umbrella) of the customer in force shows an amount owed, that amount is held back up to 0.5 of the credit balance, that is half of it; and otherwise nothing is held back.

**Records read**

- the premium balance shown on the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy at the same property address as the flood policy;
- the premium balance shown on the customer's Larkspur Umbrella policy in force;
- this premium account's credit balance.

**Truth table**

| Flood account shows a credit | HomeGuard at the same address shows an amount owed | Larkspur Umbrella in force shows an amount owed | Held back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes or no | The HomeGuard amount owed, no more than the credit balance |
| Yes | No | Yes | The Umbrella amount owed, no more than half (0.5) of the credit balance |
| Yes | No | No | Nothing |
| No | — | — | Nothing |

**Hypothetical cases,** each on a credit balance of 200.00:

- HomeGuard owes 80.00: 80.00 is held back, leaving 120.00 to refund.
- HomeGuard owes 300.00: 200.00 is held back, leaving nothing to refund.
- HomeGuard owes 80.00 and the Umbrella owes 150.00: only the HomeGuard balance is read; 80.00 is held back.
- HomeGuard owes nothing and the Umbrella owes 150.00: held back up to 100.00, so 100.00 is held back.
- HomeGuard owes nothing and the Umbrella owes 60.00: 60.00 is held back.
